title: NOR // 3 · The Norwegian Engine
concept_line: Three lanes. One system. Measure. Adapt. Repeat.

art_direction.identity: Bergen fjord performance laboratory: quiet, wet, engineered, human, never sci-fi
principles: One dominant spatial idea: three parallel lanes converging at one protocol table.
Room identity comes from material, weather and objects, never replacement global chrome.
Scientific detail should feel handled and used, not sterile or glossy.
Lava/sunrise remains a sparse Kona.m action accent; cold blue belongs to atmosphere, not UI chrome.
No athlete likeness or exact sponsor mark is bundled before rights review.
Complexity appears progressively and mobile lite mode preserves the silhouette.
materials: wet honed basalt with imperfect specular breakup
brushed aluminium and anodised dark steel
smoked oak benches with visible grain direction
low-iron glass with condensation edge treatment
paper tape, towels and handwritten protocol cards for human texture

lighting.fill: soft 4200K bounce from wet floor and glasshouse
lighting.rim: narrow 2800-3000K museum spots on achievement discs and bikes
lighting.action_accent: #FF6A00 used sparingly on protocol status and Kona horizon
lighting.depth: volumetric-style fog, layered ceiling baffles, translucent altitude glasshouse and backlit rain wall

zones.name: Rain Lock
zones.purpose: Entry through a narrow wet-stone vestibule with a backlit rain plane and boot/gear drain.

zones.name: Three Rails
zones.purpose: Three parallel bike/run lanes: shared architecture, individualized setup.

zones.name: Protocol Table
zones.purpose: Central lactate, notes, bottles, timing and analysis island; the social/scientific heart of the room.

zones.name: Altitude Glasshouse
zones.purpose: Glazed controlled-environment bay representing altitude and environmental adaptation work.

zones.name: Heat / Cool
zones.purpose: Fans, towels, heat lamp and cold-air contrast without turning the room into a spa cliché.

zones.name: Podium Vault
zones.purpose: Abstract achievement discs: shared sweeps first, then individual championships.

zones.name: Fjord Wall
zones.purpose: Layered Bergen/Askøy-inspired topographic relief, rain light and dark timber bench; no copied map tiles.

zones.name: Kona Line
zones.purpose: A razor-thin warm horizon visible from every training lane, keeping destination separate from method.

shared.treatment: three interlocking brushed-metal discs; abstract, not medal replica
three vertical stone-and-metal blades with engraved placement and race time

interaction_hotspots.copy: Measured feedback is part of the story; no medical interpretation is presented.
Shared team system, individualized athlete execution.
Controlled-environment training is represented as a spatial idea, not a claim about one exact session.
The first men’s WTS podium sweep by one nation: Stornes, Blummenfelt, Iden.
Norway swept the 2025 IRONMAN World Championship men’s podium in Nice.
The room is about method; the horizon is the destination.

evidence.claim: Norway swept the 2018 WTS Bermuda men's podium, with Casper Stornes first, Kristian Blummenfelt second and Gustav Iden third.

World Triathlon documented the Norwegian team's extensive use of measurements including repeated lactate, watts, speed, muscle oxygen saturation, aerodynamics and rolling resistance during altitude training.
Kristian Blummenfelt's official profile lists Olympic, World Triathlon, IRONMAN and IRONMAN 70.3 world titles.
Gustav Iden won the 2019 and 2021 IRONMAN 70.3 World Championships.
Gustav Iden won the 2022 IRONMAN World Championship in Kona.
Casper Stornes won the 2025 IRONMAN World Championship in Nice; Iden was second and Blummenfelt third.
Casper Stornes ran 2:29:25 in the 2025 IRONMAN World Championship marathon.

asset_policy.likeness_slot: optional external media hook; disabled by default
asset_policy.bikes: neutral low-logo triathlon-bike geometry until exact provenance and partner rights are approved
asset_policy.achievement_treatment: abstract discs/blades with factual text, not copied medal or trophy designs

estimated_external_production_cost_eur.prototype_current_branch: 0 external studio spend; procedural code and generator authored in-repo
estimated_external_production_cost_eur.note: Planning estimate, not a vendor quote. Rights/licensing and exact-scanned equipment can dominate cost.

mobile_strategy: dynamic shadows disabled on coarse-pointer lite mode
dispose materials and textures on exit

acceptance: No import from production navigation, hall or canonical room registry.
Full-room overview reads as one coherent room on entry.
The three parallel lanes are immediately legible without labels.
Shared achievement sweeps visually outrank individual trophy shelves.
Kona.m typography and global chrome semantics remain unchanged.
No unsupported athlete quote is rendered.
No athlete likeness, exact sponsor mark or copied event photography is bundled.
Materials read as wet stone, metal, timber, rubber and glass rather than plastic.
Mobile lite mode preserves the core depth silhouette and all interaction targets.
